hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A subarray is valid if no two adjacent elements in the subarray sum to a restricted forbidden value.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Track the left boundary of the current valid contiguous span as you iterate rightward.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Whenever nums[i] plus nums[i - 1] equals the forbidden sum, reset the left boundary to index i.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan updates the valid subarray start position upon adjacent violations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(n^2) subarrays with adjacent checks takes quadratic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that validity resets only at adjacent collision positions.
